Name: Easier Monsters
Author: vnmryan
Description:
I find the Stardew Valley combat leveling to be a bit of a u-curve. This mod aims to fix that. It's quite simple, reducing the attack and health of all monsters across the board, but it works for me. It just might work for you too.

[size=4]Installation[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Unzip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

Looking for more? Browse my other mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/52416251?tab=user+files]here[/url].
